title: Construction Performance Standards and Coverage Exclusions — Bridgewell New Home Builder Warranties
content:
The construction performance standards of Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties fix, for each program, the measurements above which a crack or an out-of-level floor is a workmanship defect, and the items and kinds of damage each program leaves out of coverage.

## Measured standards, in inches

| Program | Drywall crack width above which the crack is a workmanship defect | Concrete slab crack width or vertical displacement above which it is a workmanship defect | Floor deviation within any 32-inch span above which it is a workmanship defect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 0.125 | 0.1875 | 0.375 |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | 0.125 | 0.1875 | 0.375 |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | 0.125 | 0.1875 | 0.375 |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | 0.125 | 0.1875 | 0.375 |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | 0.125 | 0.1875 | 0.25 |

Each standard is met only by a measurement strictly greater than the figure: a measurement equal to the figure is not above it.

**Hypothetical measurements under a 1-2-10 program.** A drywall crack 0.13 inch wide is above 0.125 and meets the standard; one exactly 0.125 inch wide does not. A floor 0.30 inch out of level within a 32-inch span is not above 0.375 under the 1-2-10 programs, while the same 0.30 inch is above 0.25 under the Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty.

## Items never covered as workmanship

| Program | Items never covered as workmanship |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | none listed |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | landscaping; fences; swimming pools; normal shrinkage cracks under the threshold |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | landscaping; fences; swimming pools; normal shrinkage cracks under the threshold |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | landscaping; common elements; normal shrinkage cracks under the threshold |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | landscaping; fences; swimming pools; normal shrinkage cracks under the threshold |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | landscaping; fences; swimming pools |

## Damage and structures covered

The same three settings apply under all six programs:

| Kind of damage or structure | Covered under every program |
|---|---|
| Mold damage | No |
| Detached garages and outbuildings | No |
| Common elements of an attached-home association | No |
